policy:
(version 1)
(allow default)
(deny network*)
(deny file-read-data)
(deny file-write*)
(deny process-exec)
(deny process-fork)
(allow file-read-data (literal "/"))
(allow file-read-data (literal "/private"))
(allow file-read-data (literal "/private/tmp"))
(allow file-read-data (literal "/private/var/tmp"))
(allow file-read-data (literal "/usr/bin"))
(allow file-read-data (subpath "/System"))
(allow file-read-data (subpath "/dev"))
(allow file-read-data (subpath "/private/preboot"))
(allow file-read-data (subpath "/usr/lib"))
(allow file-read-data (subpath "/usr/share"))
(allow file-read-data (subpath "/private/var/db/dyld"))
(allow file-read-data (subpath "/private/var/db/timezone"))
(allow file-read-data (subpath "<scratch>"))
(allow file-write* (subpath "<scratch>"))
(allow file-write-data (literal "/dev/null") (literal "/dev/dtracehelper"))
(allow file-read-data (literal "<scratch>/keychain-presence"))
(allow process-exec (literal "<scratch>/keychain-presence"))
(allow file-read-data (literal "/Users/kent/.claude.json"))
(allow file-read-data (literal "/Users/kent/.claude/.credentials.json"))
(allow file-read-data (literal "/Users/kent/.CFUserTextEncoding"))
(allow file-read-data (literal "/private/var/db/mds/messages/501/se_SecurityMessages"))
